method_goal: Train a Transformer sequence-to-sequence model from preprocessed German-English translation data with label smoothing and scheduled optimization.

stages.name: Input preparation
stages.purpose: Prepare serialized translation data from raw corpora.

mechanisms.description: The preprocessing pipeline downloads and merges translation corpora, learns BPE codes, encodes the splits, filters examples by maximum length, builds vocabulary, and serializes the processed data.

stages.name: Transformer computation
stages.purpose: Encode and decode token sequences through attention and feed-forward sublayers.

mechanisms.description: Encoder layers apply multi-head self-attention followed by position-wise feed-forward transformation.
Decoder layers apply decoder self-attention, encoder-decoder attention, and position-wise feed-forward transformation.

stages.name: Scheduled optimization
stages.purpose: Optimize the Transformer with label smoothing and warmup learning-rate scheduling.

mechanisms.description: Each training step forwards source and target tensors through the model, computes performance with optional label smoothing, backpropagates, and applies the scheduled optimizer update.
ScheduledOptim updates the learning rate using the Transformer warmup formula controlled by d_model, warmup steps, step count, and lr multiplier.

writing_constraints: Do not claim this implementation is academically novel without author confirmation.
Treat shell comments about better settings as soft hints unless confirmed by hard evidence or author input.
alignment_notes: train.py:main is experiment orchestration, while train.py:train_epoch and transformer modules provide method-core evidence.
train_multi30k_de_en.sh provides concrete runtime settings such as batch size, warmup steps, epochs, label smoothing, and tensorboard.
